parse.title: Big Chompy Bird Hunting/Quick guide
parse.wikitext:
===Fletching some arrows===
*Note: You must make the arrows yourself to progress.

{{Checklist|
*Chop down at least 3 [[achey tree]]s immediately south-west of Rantz.
*Use a [[knife]] on the [[Achey tree logs|logs]] to make [[ogre arrow shaft]]s.
*Use 100 [[feather]]s on the ogre arrow shafts.
*Obtain 4 [[wolf bones]] (south-west from Rantz).
*Use a [[chisel]] on the bones.
*Use the [[wolfbone arrowtips]] on the [[flighted ogre arrow]]s.
*Use the [[ogre arrow]]s on Rantz.
}}
